newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek island ferry runs aground, passengers safe.
newsitem.headline: Greek island ferry runs aground, passengers safe.

text.p: A Greek ferry run aground near the port of the Aegean island of Astipalaia on Tuesday but all 20 passengers were carried to safety by coast guard boats, the Merchant Marine Ministry said.
It said the Super Naias ferry ran aground because of strong winds as it was trying to dock.

Another ferry, carrying 22 passengers and a crew of 17, was adrift for several hours between the eastern Aegean islands of Rhodes and Kastellorizo after an electrical failure, the ministry said in a statement.
It said the Syros Express was on its way to Rhodes after partly repairing the damage.
